create_MemoryStreamBridge: create an in-memory stream bridge for per-run event logging with bounded event retention
publish_stream_events: publish events to an in-memory stream bridge for a given run_id with event name and data payload
subscribe_to_stream: subscribe to an in-memory stream bridge as an async iterator yielding StreamEvent objects with optional Last-Event-ID replay
publish_end_stream: signal the end of an event stream for a given run_id on the in-memory stream bridge
cleanup_stream_bridge: cleanup and release resources for a specific run_id or close all streams on the in-memory stream bridge
